roadmap_updates.rationale: Per-resource native cwd selection is integrated and tested in a real Windows shell; only canonical existing workspace-relative directories are accepted. Starting directory is not an OS sandbox; Unix and complete profile UI remain separate.

Up to8 named resource-owned real shells and8 retained views; unique labels, independent state/stop, stale-run rejection and persisted metadata tested. Full naming/editor UX and ancient metadata lookup beyond latest100 still limited.
Shell/cwd/resource/run/status metadata survives restart; no terminal text/environment persisted. Reopen honestly reports STOPPED. UI currently loads latest100 records; no live reattachment.

Selector and native Canvas/Project badges track current run state; tested RUNNING/STOPPED without persisting it as canvas/task status. Historical/unmounted badges and broader session telemetry remain limited.

Exact native requirement satisfied: all active persisted agent records for the opened workspace reconcile STOPPED, including records beyond a200-row page; DONE and other-workspace state are preserved. This is metadata reconciliation, not live process resumption.
Native shell presets and per-resource shell/cwd metadata retained. Custom saved shell profiles and full profile-management UI remain incomplete.

UI ACK backpressure and bounded transport/view pools tested, including intentional consumer stall/resume. User scrollback/search and complete retention budgets remain unimplemented; no completion credit added.

Real Windows ConPTY now supports independently owned bounded resource slots and per-run supervision; existing native input/output/resize/stop plus new isolation tests pass. Full older-Windows teardown/soak certification remains.

Scoped database/request tests extended with live shells across different roots, same-root epochs, and invalid-root preservation. Broader hostile path races, OS sandboxing and transactional failure recovery are not claimed.

Actual live shells remain independent across tool/view changes and output bursts; bounded process fixture timeout/cancel behavior retained. Long-duration soak and detached supervisor tests still pending.
This pass tests orderly restart, stale run rejection and seeded interrupted metadata, not actual crash-injection/transport reconnection. Exact crash/reconnect acceptance remains open.

Retained native terminal views are bounded to8 and transport applies consumer backpressure; hidden screens still parse output. Full offscreen surface suspension and multi-agent frame-time performance remain open.
Terminal cards now select independent native resource screens; surfaces remain inspector-hosted, not fully embedded inside each canvas card. Agent/editor per-card live parity remains open.
Run-token and workspace validation improved; execution grant still workspace-session-wide, not arbitrary per-agent/per-resource persisted permission scopes.
